g.text: · sessions are added only while DRAFT
· a session's slot falls inside dateRange
· publish() needs at least one session
and is allowed only from DRAFT
Checks the candidate slot against every session in
the catalogue: a speaker may not be booked for two
+addSession(sessionId, title, Track, TimeSlot, speakerId, SeatCapacity, Price) : Session
Value objects are Java records, mapped as
JPA @Embeddable. Session is inside the Event
Speaker is a separate aggregate referenced
only by id. EventStatus.CANCELLED exists, but
no use case on main sets it.
